precedence: non-normative snapshot; sealed assurance/source/tasks.json and authenticated source-bound receipts override

tasks.title: Freeze immutable revision, baseline and original artifacts
tasks.red_test: Compare GitHub head/base/runner SHA with stale or swapped SHA
tasks.acceptance: Any drift causes HOLD before further gate; baseline environment and real bytes captured

tasks.title: Generalize PR8-only meta evidence policy
tasks.red_test: Present valid PR14/main evidence to old PR8-only verifier; require negative failure
tasks.acceptance: Valid current HEAD accepted, stale/forged/unsupported event rejected with machine-readable reason

tasks.title: Assert compulsory test identities and minimum coverage
tasks.red_test: Remove lead atomicity test while retaining >= MIN_TESTS total
tasks.acceptance: Mandatory test identity absent => FAIL regardless total count; no silent skip/xfail

tasks.title: Independent mobile budgets and CLS adjudication
tasks.red_test: Present raw p75 LCP above 2500 while consistent summary claims success
tasks.acceptance: Independent verifier fails for any breach; no field INP claim

tasks.title: Bind event SHA, checkout HEAD and artifact source
tasks.red_test: Substitute merge event SHA as execution_sha or re-run with changed base
tasks.acceptance: Verifier rejects drift; PR and main receipts remain disjoint

tasks.title: Independently verify provider ZIP bytes and manifests
tasks.red_test: Modify one PNG chunk/ZIP CRC/manifest SHA, preserve workflow success
tasks.acceptance: All required artifacts checked; failures remain HOLD; provider authentication provenance recorded

tasks.title: Reproducibility and nondeterminism inventory
tasks.red_test: Run same fixed seed twice with locale/timezone/env variance
tasks.acceptance: Every difference classified; source build reproducibility not asserted if unverified

tasks.title: Construct reusable claim-argument-evidence graph
tasks.red_test: Supply a complete list with one unavailable proof
tasks.acceptance: Claim is PASS iff all mandatory proof leaves PASS at compatible SHA and target

tasks.title: Enable FK enforcement per SQLite connection
tasks.red_test: Insert outbox with nonexistent lead_id; currently SQLite FK not enabled in db()
tasks.acceptance: Every write path rejects orphan with IntegrityError; foreign_key_check reports zero after approved remediation

tasks.title: Migration and legacy-FK compatibility proof
tasks.red_test: Legacy database includes old schema and an intentionally orphaned row
tasks.acceptance: Repeated migration exact schema; no data loss; conflicts report BLOCKED and do not quietly repair

tasks.title: Linearizable idempotency and quota transaction
tasks.red_test: Concurrent same key across threads/processes under near-capacity SQLite locking
tasks.acceptance: Same key + same body -> same id; same key + different body -> 409; accepted state atomic

tasks.title: Crash cutpoints around HTTP 201 and durable commit
tasks.red_test: SIGKILL at before BEGIN/after insert/before commit/after commit/before reply
tasks.acceptance: For all cuts: no uncommitted 201, no lost committed lead, replay consistent

tasks.title: Cross-reload client idempotency without PII retention
tasks.red_test: Accept server-side, drop response, reload and submit unchanged form
tasks.acceptance: Replay semantics preserved if same user intent; explicitly documented boundary for new intent

tasks.title: Crash-safe restore generation and rollback
tasks.red_test: SIGKILL/EIO/ENOSPC at each rename/fsync and metadata operation
tasks.acceptance: No scenario produces irrecoverable partial state; old/new integrity and watermark checked

tasks.title: Authenticated encrypted off-device backup chain
tasks.red_test: Destroy local root/data and backup directory in a disposable isolated environment
tasks.acceptance: Provider receipt + offline restore verified against source snapshot; local-only copies not counted

tasks.title: Independent host restore, watermark and RPO/RTO measurement
tasks.red_test: Delete original machine and restore without source disk or server.log
tasks.acceptance: No unreconciled known loss; actual RPO/RTO numbers and limitations recorded; owner adopts thresholds

tasks.title: HTTP parser absolute deadlines and protocol negative suite
tasks.red_test: Trickled headers/body, early EOF, conflicting length, media range fuzz under small MAX_CONNECTIONS
tasks.acceptance: Bound wall-clock and connection slots, correct status class, zero partial commits

tasks.title: Reverse proxy trust and TLS edge attestation
tasks.red_test: Spoof XFF/XFP from untrusted peer; spoof chain and IPv6 identities
tasks.acceptance: No quota bypass/false HSTS with untrusted headers; actual edge evidence separate

tasks.title: Constrain outbound destinations and redirects
tasks.red_test: Hostile redirects, private-IP targets, DNS rebinding, non-TLS and credentials in URL
tasks.acceptance: No signed lead crosses unapproved destination; synthetic tests isolate external network

tasks.title: At-least-once channel/receiver contract and acknowledgment
tasks.red_test: Synthetic 2xx before durable receiver acknowledgment; 408/429/5xx and timeout
tasks.acceptance: No accepted lead lost; retries bounded; all ACK claims tied to external receipt ID

tasks.title: Rate limit topology, clock and resource accounting
tasks.red_test: 25k identities, IPv6 /64 churn, wall jumps, two independently spawned servers
tasks.acceptance: No unbounded memory nor quota bypass within declared topology; unsupported topology fail closed

tasks.title: Config to DOM trust-boundary and XSS negative suite
tasks.red_test: Inject malformed href, quotes, svg/javascript schemes via fake public config
tasks.acceptance: All payloads inert, console signals captured, CSP intact, negative mutation kills regression

tasks.title: Broaden security scanning and dependency provenance
tasks.red_test: Inject XSS/SSRF-like sink, scanner crash, omitted requirement, altered wheel hash
tasks.acceptance: Findings and gaps machine reported; waiver requires owner rationale; no full ASVS certification claim

tasks.title: Least privilege and resource sandbox of site runtime
tasks.red_test: Attempt to read files outside sandbox, exhaust tasks/memory, abuse writable root
tasks.acceptance: Resource caps and file/network boundaries proven, no break of media/API/backup

tasks.title: Manual + automated WCAG matrix across both themes
tasks.red_test: Focus traps, enlarged text 200%, empty labels, error states, modal mode
tasks.acceptance: No critical WCAG A/AA finding; manual evidence named; axe alone never claimed complete

tasks.title: Independent full lab CWV repeatability
tasks.red_test: Force slow LCP or late shift while internally consistent summary says PASS
tasks.acceptance: Independent budget violation rejects; field INP remains unknown

tasks.title: Field INP/CWV with privacy-respecting RUM or CrUX
tasks.red_test: Inject long input tasks into critical user flow
tasks.acceptance: Measured p75 by mobile/desktop meets owner-approved objectives or release HOLD

tasks.title: Theme switch stability, contrast under dynamic media
tasks.red_test: Load font after 500ms, dark/bright sampled frames, extreme landscape viewport
tasks.acceptance: Any unprompted shift/contrast violation rejected at measured state with raw screenshots

tasks.title: Critical media and network budget as a regression contract
tasks.red_test: Add unexpected high-priority video/font preload or corrupt poster
tasks.acceptance: Per-profile transfer budgets from measured baseline; no broken poster or blank hero

tasks.title: Canonical metadata, SEO indexability, authoritative FQDN
tasks.red_test: Change canonical, og image or JSON-LD to mismatched domain
tasks.acceptance: Canonical/schema/OG agree with owner-approved DNS+TLS; search indexing cannot be asserted absent field proof

tasks.title: Business/contact and tariff single-source consistency
tasks.red_test: Make JCB rate or VAT differ across JSON/JS/HTML while math still passes
tasks.acceptance: No unapproved published rate or hidden VAT semantics; arithmetic independent oracle passes

tasks.title: Media licensing/provenance and true-claim inventory
tasks.red_test: Remove permission record for one video while bytes/hash remain valid
tasks.acceptance: Every release asset has matched source rights and owner authorization; unresolved rights block publication

tasks.title: Separate liveness, readiness, delivery and business acceptance
tasks.red_test: Worker heartbeat fresh with 100 stale pending jobs and no receiver ACK
tasks.acceptance: No metric implies greater assurance than observed; unknown/failed channel blocks release

tasks.title: Predeclare production SLI/SLO/alert thresholds
tasks.red_test: Report 100% availability from synthetic soak with no field requests
tasks.acceptance: Adopted pre-run SLO; no backfilled goals; actual monitored values with data-quality bounds

tasks.title: Correlate host, power-guard and external monitoring failures
tasks.red_test: Trigger false heartbeat DOWN during intentional power guard; real failed sender
tasks.acceptance: Each incident has provider event ID and root-cause status; unknown remains unknown

tasks.title: Authorize actual privacy processing and notices
tasks.red_test: Find contact form with no approved policy and no documented retention authorization
tasks.acceptance: Signed/recorded policy edition and purpose/retention decision or legal HOLD

tasks.title: Retention, deletion and backup lifecycle consistency
tasks.red_test: Insert expired and legal-hold records, simulate deletion and restoration from old backup
tasks.acceptance: Data lifecycle verified; no irreversible auto-delete without approved policy

tasks.title: Commercial effective-dated rates and quote semantics
tasks.red_test: Compare 1C external proposed rates with site, inject conflicting quote or rounding
tasks.acceptance: Unknown or conflicting rate => publish HOLD or label explicitly unverified; no unapproved assumptions

tasks.title: Domain TLS edge, production rollout and rollback rehearsal
tasks.red_test: Certificate mismatch, wrong DNS target, missing redirect/HSTS, broken new rollout
tasks.acceptance: DNS/TLS/rollback proof and owner authorization separate from source CI

tasks.title: Conjunctive owner release acceptance B1–B9 + T1–T7
tasks.red_test: Keep one source absent and run green CI
tasks.acceptance: Release PASS iff all mandatory leaves are evidence-verified at target version and owner deploy authorization exists

tasks.title: Threat model with attack trees and known trust boundaries
tasks.red_test: New data flow bypasses source-sink inventory without requiring update
tasks.acceptance: Every high-impact path linked to at least one test and owner of risk

tasks.title: Mutation score on critical safety and integrity contracts
tasks.red_test: Mutate HMAC verification, FK checks, dedup uniqueness, replay or budget bounds
tasks.acceptance: All designated critical mutants killed; score measured without arbitrary blanket 100% claim

tasks.title: Model/state-machine cross-process and temporal fault test
tasks.red_test: Schedule concurrent retry, quota, crash and worker states with fake time
tasks.acceptance: Minimal counterexample recorded; no lost accepted lead or silent invariant breach

tasks.title: Extended measured soak with anti-leak and adversarial events
tasks.red_test: Inject stuck downstream, server restart, disk pressure, repeated packet faults
tasks.acceptance: Observed duration, integrity, backlog and process samples pass independent checker at same SHA

tasks.title: Date/locale/DST, integer precision, and boundary fuzz
tasks.red_test: Time-zone offset around DST/day boundary, malformed Unicode and huge integer
tasks.acceptance: All documented boundary cases invariant or explicit rejection; discrepancies fixed or scoped

tasks.title: Supply-chain attestations and sandbox anti-tamper
tasks.red_test: Change action pin or wheel hash and replay stale receipt
tasks.acceptance: Mutation rejected; valid source/runner/dependency manifest reproducible within documented limits

tasks.title: Real-device accessibility and UI adversarial evaluation
tasks.red_test: 200% text, high contrast, reduced motion, keyboard only, screen reader, iOS Safari
tasks.acceptance: No unresolved WCAG AA critical failure and recorded field boundary; owner visual approval separate

tasks.title: Final assurance case with signed release/no-release decision
tasks.red_test: Withdraw one mandatory provider receipt after all code gates become green
tasks.acceptance: Zero mandatory unknowns, no new P0/P1, current immutable code proof, owner authorization; otherwise HOLD
